design: Use seven adjacent disjoint chronological pairs per series, leaving exposure 15 unobserved. Read the nine exact raw tiles from the prior calibrator design. Separate R/G1/G2/B before taking (B-A)/sqrt(2), retain complete disjoint 2x2 blocks on each parity lattice. For the same centered block variables compare actual variance of sum with the diagonal sum of variances; also retain physical lag checks at two native pixels. Compare one-level flat-minus-Bias variance excess per mean ADU as conditional descriptor only. Use the 3-second Bias only as matched-duration dark. Do not infer detector gain, dose linearity, independence of paired spatial tiles, or native processing behavior.
